items.criterion: A message handed to the sending interface from a verified domain is accepted and becomes a message row.
items.judgment: Call the send route with a verified sender and read the row back.

items.criterion: A replayed idempotency key returns the stored acceptance and queues nothing further.
items.judgment: Send twice under one key and count the message rows.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous sends under one idempotency key leave exactly one message.
items.judgment: Fire both sends together and count the rows for that key.

items.criterion: Every overview counter equals the count of message rows in that state and window.
items.judgment: Read the counters and compare each against the row count.

items.criterion: The delivery chart buckets sum to the counters exactly.
items.judgment: Sum the buckets per state and compare against the counter.

items.criterion: A hard bounce records a diagnostic and writes a suppression row for the address.
items.judgment: Send to the reserved bounced address and read the event and the suppression.

items.criterion: A message to an ordinary recipient reaches the mail server inbox with its subject.
items.judgment: Read the inbox for that address and match the subject.

items.criterion: A minted credential returns its secret once and stores a twelve-character prefix.
items.judgment: Mint, read the response, then read the stored row.

items.criterion: A credential listing carries no secret.
items.judgment: List credentials and search the body for the minted secret.

items.criterion: A created domain generates a signature, a return path and a tracking record, each with a status of its own.
items.judgment: Add a domain and read the generated record rows.

items.criterion: A verification pass refreshes each record status and leaves a domain with a missing record pending.
items.judgment: Request a pass on the seeded pending domain and read the statuses.

items.criterion: A late event is appended without walking the message state backwards.
items.judgment: Apply an out-of-order event and read the state and the event rows.

items.criterion: The log filters on the server and returns every matching row.
items.judgment: Filter by state and compare the returned rows against the row count.

items.criterion: A message detail returns its events in occurrence order.
items.judgment: Read the detail and compare the occurrence instants in sequence.

items.criterion: A member minting a credential is denied and no credential row is written.
items.judgment: Call the mint route as a member and count the rows.

items.criterion: A member sending a broadcast to a live audience is denied and the broadcast stays unsent.
items.judgment: Call the send route as a member and read the broadcast state.

items.criterion: A domain belonging to another workspace answers as not found.
items.judgment: Request the other workspace's domain and read the status.

items.criterion: Upserting a contact by address leaves one row for that address.
items.judgment: Create the same address twice and count the contact rows.

items.criterion: A send past the monthly allowance is refused before anything is queued.
items.judgment: Spend the allowance, send again and count the message rows.

items.criterion: A replayed notification keeps its original event identifier.
items.judgment: Replay a recorded attempt and compare the event identifiers.
